# Rosace

Rosace (rosace.app) is a browser-based motion graphics tool. It runs entirely in the browser. No software to install. No design experience required. It is free to use.

## Problem it solves

Creating animated videos usually requires expensive tools like After Effects or Jitter, or complex free tools like Cavalry. Most people who need animated content — founders, marketers, developers, solo creators — are not motion designers. They don't have the time or skills to learn complex software. Rosace is built for them. It makes animation simple and accessible.

## What users can do

- Upload an audio track and sync animations to the beat automatically
- Animate text, shapes, and device mockups
- Export finished videos to MP4 or WEBM
- Resize any animation to 16:9, 9:16, or 1:1 in one click
- Reuse animations across multiple projects
- Download exports without any watermark, on any plan

## How it compares to competitors

- After Effects: industry standard, very complex, expensive subscription
- Cavalry: free, but as complex as After Effects
- Jitter: cleaner UI than After Effects, but still complex and expensive
- Rosace: free, simple, no design skills needed

## Business model

The core product is free forever. No credit card required to start. A paid tier exists and unlocks AI-powered features. No watermarks on any plan, including free.

## Status

Rosace is currently in beta. The app is live at app.rosace.app.
